camel_example: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator GET /api/v1/slots --region cn-hangzhou --Order Desc --StorageType OSS --Phase Running --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --EndpointIds 'endp-my1tk3jggooi5uwks5' --SortBy GmtCreateTime --SlotIds 'slot-my1tk3jggooi5u0000,slot-n69468yvjz8d120000,slot-tga4omjrepklkg0000' --StorageUri 'example-string' --InstanceIds 'inst-my1tk3jggooi5u0000' --Name acc_instance_slot_1 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Lists information about dataset acceleration slots
description_zh: 获取数据集加速槽的信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator list-slots --slot-ids slot-my1tk3jggooi5u0000,slot-n69468yvjz8d120000,slot-tga4omjrepklkg0000 --instance-ids inst-my1tk3jggooi5u0000 --name acc_instance_slot_1 --storage-type OSS --phase Running --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order Desc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --endpoint-ids endp-my1tk3jggooi5uwks5 --storage-uri example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSlots

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the dataset acceleration slots. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,)
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速槽ID的列表，多个加速槽ID以半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: slot_ids

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the dataset acceleration instance to which the slot belongs. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467899.html
parameters.help_zh: 加速槽所对应的数据集加速实例的唯一标识符。如何获取加速实例ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467899.html
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset acceleration slot. Fuzzy matching is supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速槽名称，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The data storage type of the dataset acceleration slot. Valid values:

OSS: OSS file storage.

NAS: NAS file storage
parameters.help_zh:
数据集加速槽的数据存储类型，取值如下：
OSS：OSS文件存储。
NAS：NAS文件存储
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the dataset acceleration slot. Valid values:

Created: The slot is created.

Preparing: Resources are being prepared.

Loading: Data is being loaded.

Running: The slot is running and providing services.

Reloading: Data is being reloaded.

Succeed: The operation is successful.

Failed: The operation failed.

Stopping: The slot is being stopped.

Stopped: The slot is stopped
parameters.help_zh:
数据集加速槽所处状态，取值如下：
Created：已创建。
Preparing：正在准备资源。
Loading：正在加载数据。
Running：正在运行，提供服务。
Reloading：正在重新加载数据。
Succeed：成功完成。
Failed：已失败。
Stopping：正在停止。
Stopped：已停止
parameters.name: phase

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

Desc: Descending order.

Asc: Ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排列顺序，取值如下：
Desc： 降序排列。
Asc： 升序排列
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number of the slot list. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 加速槽列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of slots to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的加速槽数量，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the accelerated mount target that is associated with the slot
parameters.help_zh: 加速槽所对应的数据集加速挂载点的唯一标识符
parameters.name: endpoint_ids

parameters.help_en: The data storage path (URI) of the dataset acceleration slot
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速槽的数据存储路径（URI）
parameters.name: storage_uri
